notes: When already fighting, C ignores the typed target and uses FIGHTING(ch); the wrong-argument vehicle reaches the opponent's success arm.
C's actor act names the target and the actual wielded object's short description.
C's victim act names the actual wielded object's short description.
C's TO_NOTVICT act names the actual wielded object and excludes the victim.
After target resolution, C checks GET_EQ(vict, WEAR_WIELD) before combat-state validation and emits the exact target-pronoun act.
Failed roll emits the actor's exact stumble message and leaves the actor sitting.
Failed roll emits the exact victim-facing stumble message.
Failed roll emits the exact TO_NOTVICT stumble message.
